title: Composition of the Monthly DIC Payment to a Surviving Spouse
content:
## Rule

The monthly Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) payable to a surviving spouse is the total of the following amounts, each being the figure set for the award's rate category:

1. the basic rate;
2. the 8-year addition, on a rate category with the 8-Year Provision;
3. the housebound addition or the aid-and-attendance addition of the rate category — never both;
4. the child addition, once for each child on the award who is under the child age limit;
5. the transitional benefit, for the first months of entitlement making up the transitional benefit period, while a child under 18 is on the award.

Amounts are kept to the cent. A monthly payment is released only while the award status is running.

The rule governs both the regular monthly payment and each month covered by a retroactive release of past-due DIC.

## Restated as conditions

| Component | Included in a month when | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| Basic rate | Always | Once |
| 8-year addition | The award's rate category is one with the 8-Year Provision | Once |
| Housebound addition | The rate category is a housebound category | Once; never together with the aid-and-attendance addition |
| Aid-and-attendance addition | The rate category is an aid-and-attendance category | Once; never together with the housebound addition |
| Child addition | A child on the award is under the child age limit | Once per such child |
| Transitional benefit | The month is within the transitional benefit period counted from the start of entitlement, and a child under 18 is on the award | Once |

## Release of a monthly payment

The status that decides whether a monthly payment is released is the recorded status of that same award.

| Recorded status of the award | Monthly payment released? |
|---|---|
| Running | Yes |
| Suspended | No |
| Terminated | No |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures, for illustration only — not rates)

Assume these illustrative inputs: a basic rate of 1000.00, a housebound addition of 100.00, a child addition of 200.00 and a transitional benefit of 300.00; an award in a housebound category without the 8-Year Provision; two children on the award, both under the child age limit and under 18; and the award status running.

- A month inside the transitional benefit period: 1000.00, plus 100.00, plus twice 200.00 (400.00), plus 300.00, totals 1800.00.
- A month after the transitional benefit period has ended, with the same two children still on the award: 1000.00, plus 100.00, plus 400.00, totals 1500.00.
- The same month after the period, once one child is no longer under the child age limit: 1000.00, plus 100.00, plus 200.00, totals 1300.00.
- Any of these months while the award status is suspended: no monthly payment is released.
